name: building
description: Urban and rural buildings with an immediate point of interest

entries.value: Roadside Inn — clean beds, guarded stables, and a common room where couriers exchange news.
Crowded Tavern — cheap food, loud music, private booths, and regular fights over local politics.
Town House — a narrow multi-story home with a workshop below and family rooms above.
Farmstead — a sturdy house, barns, sheds, fenced animals, and signs of a recent disturbance.
Blacksmith — a hot stone workshop taking commissions while quietly repairing forbidden weapons.
General Store — shelves of practical supplies and a locked cabinet of unusual trade-ins.
Public Bathhouse — tiled pools, rented lockers, gossiping attendants, and discreet meeting rooms.
Brothel — a guarded, professionally run house offering companionship, information, and strict privacy.
Temple — a public sanctuary with an altar, charitable kitchen, archives, and restricted crypt.
Guardhouse — cells, an armory, duty records, and exhausted officers changing shifts.
Apothecary — fragrant shelves of remedies, poisons, preserved creatures, and mislabeled experiments.
Guildhall — offices, training spaces, a contract board, and a members-only meeting chamber.
Warehouse — stacked cargo, overhead walkways, night watchmen, and one shipment missing from the ledger.
Theater — ornate public seating, cramped backstage passages, workshops, and hidden royal boxes.
Schoolhouse — a single crowded classroom whose teacher knows every family secret in the district.
Bank — reinforced counters, private offices, document vaults, and a heavily trapped treasury.
Mill — a water- or wind-powered workplace surrounded by dust, noise, laborers, and moving machinery.
Stable — rented mounts, tack rooms, sleeping lofts, and a groom who notices every arrival.
Courthouse — public hearing chamber, evidence rooms, legal archives, and judges' private offices.
Wizard's Tower — an eccentric vertical residence whose rooms do not follow exterior dimensions.
Embassy — a fortified noble residence operating under foreign laws and constant surveillance.
Observatory — a domed hilltop laboratory tracking stars, weather, and something approaching from above.
Abandoned Manor — a decaying estate left furnished after its occupants vanished during dinner.
Underground Fighting Pit — a concealed arena with betting rooms, healers, cages, and bribed officials.
